attr.title: Higgins
attr.desc: Weizenbaum's ELIZA (1966), running its DOCTOR script in Japanese, on a handheld with no keyboard. The engine is Anthony Hay's faithful C++ reimplementation, unmodified - the original 1966 script is what answers you. Japanese is typed with the gamepad alone: hold a consonant row with the left hand, tap a vowel with the right, and the kana appears; the left stick converts it to kanji through a bundled Mozc engine, with segment resize on RT + left stick. Named after Henry Higgins, who taught a flower girl to talk.
attr.inst: Extract to your ports folder. Nothing else is needed - the script, the dictionary and the font are all inside.
